benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Airtel Axis Bank Credit Card is one of the few credit cards in India offering substantial savings on utility spends. Being a co-branded card, it is designed to offerbenefits to Airtel customers in the form of cashback on mobile recharges, broadband, DTH, utility bill payment, etc. through the Airtel Thanks App. Cardholders can earn 25% cashback on Airtel bill payments and 10% cashback on other utility bill payments via the Airtel Thanks app. However, the benefits are not limited to this app. Cardholders can also earn 10% value-back on select everyday brands like Zomato, Blinkit, and District Movies. Besides this, the card offers a base cashback of 1%. However, effective 12 April, one important thing to note is that the accelerated cashback is capped based on spends in the base cashback category. The cashback for 25% category is capped at 2X of the base category spends in the same month, while the cashback for 10% category is capped at the same amount as the base category spends in that month. Besides this, 10% value-back on partner merchants is offered via partner wallet and not as direct cashback. Consumers who frequently spend on these brands can still maximize the value from it. However, consumers need to spend more on the base cashback category to maximize benefit from the accelerated cashback, which may not be suitable for everyone. Also, earlier the card used to offer complimentary lounge access, but effective 12 April, this benefit has been discontinued, which might impact the card’s overall value. Read on to know more about this co-branded credit card.

faqs.q: How to redeem the welcome voucher earned via Airtel Credit Card?
faqs.a: To redeem the Amazon gift voucher worth Rs. 250, earned as a welcome benefit on this credit card, you need to follow these steps. Go to www.amazon.in/addgiftcard. Enter the gift card or voucher code in the required field. Click on ‘Add to your balance’. Note that, you can redeem the welcome benefit only when you have an amazon account. In case you do not have one, you need to first create a new Amazon account and then proceed with redemption.

faqs.q: How do I receive the cashback earned via Axis Bank Airtel Credit Card?
faqs.a: The cashback offered on Airtel and other bill payments will be auto-credited to your monthly statement. It will be reflected in the next month’s credit card statement as ‘cashback credited’ and adjusted against the next month’s bill. It will be credited to your next billing cycle within three days before the next statement generation. However, the value-back offered on Zomato, Blinkit, and District Movies will be credited to the respective partner’s wallet.

faqs.q: What are the annual finance charges on this card?
faqs.a: Finance charge on the Airtel Axis Bank Credit Card is 3.75% per month i.e. 55.55% per annum.

faqs.q: Is there an annual fee waiver criteria on the card?
faqs.a: Yes, you can avail the annual fee waiver of Rs. 500 on the card on completing the annual spends of Rs. 2 Lakh in the previous year.

faqs.q: Who should apply for the Airtel Axis Bank Credit Card?
faqs.a: Airtel customers who frequently manage bill payments and recharges through the Airtel Thanks App and prefer to get cashback on their spends should apply for an Airtel Axis Bank Credit Card. This card is also well-suited for individuals seeking a low annual fee card that provides value-back on utility bill payments as well as frequent users of Zomato, Blinkit, and District Movies.

faqs.q: Does the Airtel Axis Bank Credit Card offer cashback on electricity, gas and water bill payments?
faqs.a: Yes, Airtel Axis Bank credit card offers up to 10% cashback on utility bill payments for electricity, gas and water when paid via Airtel Thanks app. However, utility bills paid outside Airtel Thanks app do not earn any cashback through this card.

faqs.q: Can I apply for the Airtel Axis Bank Credit Card without having an Airtel mobile number?
faqs.a: Yes, you do not need to have an Airtel mobile number to apply for an Airtel Axis credit card. Customers with mobile numbers associated with any network can apply for this card.

faqs.q: What should I do if my Airtel Axis Bank Credit Card is lost or stolen?
faqs.a: If your Airtel Axis Bank credit card is lost or stolen, you should first block your credit card by logging into your credit card account via Axis bank app or website. This would prevent any unauthorised transactions from your card and limit your losses. Next, report the card loss to Axis Bank customer care and request for issuance of its replacement.

faqs.question: Is the Airtel Axis Bank Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: Yes, especially if you use Airtel for mobile, broadband or DTH. The card still offers very good cashback, though you now need regular eligible spends to maximise the Airtel and utility cashback.

faqs.question: What is the annual fee of the Airtel Axis Bank Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The annual fee is ₹500 + GST. It is waived on eligible annual spends above ₹2 lakh.
